targets.root_selector:
# State timeline row: every sample in the range as a state code (0 Down, 1 OK,
# 2 Degraded, 3 Paused, 4 Unknown). Booleans map true 1, false 0. Samples of one
# collector run share a timestamp; the worst member wins (0, 4, 2, 3, then 1) and
# a run missing any of the 1 members is Unknown. A gap longer than
# the freshness bound ends in null at (sample + bound), so no state stretches across
# missing telemetry; a newest sample older than the bound also ends in null at
# (sample + bound), with a second null at now so Unknown reaches the right edge.
# Provider errors and truncation fail visibly.
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601;
def code: if type == "boolean" then (if . then 1 else 0 end)
  else (try tonumber catch null) | if . != null and IN(0, 1, 2, 3, 4) then . else 4 end end;
def worst: if any(.[]; . == 0) then 0 elif any(.[]; . == 4) then 4 elif any(.[]; . == 2) then 2
  elif any(.[]; . == 3) then 3 else 1 end;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Monitoring response truncated; shorten the time range")
else
  [.timeSeries[]? | .points[]? |
    {t: (try (.interval.endTime | stamp) catch null),
     v: (.value | if has("boolValue") then .boolValue else (.int64Value // .doubleValue) end)}] |
  map(select(.t != null and .t <= now + 120)) |
  group_by(.t) | map({t: .[0].t, n: length, v: ([.[].v | code] | worst)}) as $runs |
  [range(0; $runs | length) as $i | $runs[$i] as $r |
    {time: ($r.t | todateiso8601), value: (if $r.n == 1 then $r.v else 4 end)},
    (if $i + 1 < ($runs | length) and $runs[$i + 1].t - $r.t > 360
     then {time: ($r.t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null} else empty end)] +
  (if ($runs | length) == 0 then [{time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   elif now - ($runs | last | .t) > 360
   then [{time: ($runs | last | .t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null}, {time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   else [] end) |
  .[]
end

# Newest same-run snapshot of one collector component's numeric fields
# (worker_timing or metabase_probe). [{"key":"restart_age_seconds","label":"Running for"}] is a list of
# {key, label, scale?, state_key?}: scale multiplies (epoch seconds to ms);
# state_key names a same-run state field whose 0 (failed) turns the value into -1
# and whose 2 (overdue) turns it into -2, so the panel maps them to words; a missing
# state sample makes the value null (No report) rather than an unqualified age.
# Missing, negative, non-integer, stale (> 360 s) or future (> 120 s) samples are
# null, never zero. Provider errors and truncation fail visibly.
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Collector response truncated; shorten the time range")
else
  [.timeSeries[]? | {field: .metric.labels.field, p: (.points | sort_by(.interval.endTime) | last)} |
    select(.p != null)] as $rows |
  ([$rows[].p.interval.endTime] | max) as $end |
  (try ($end | stamp) catch null) as $t |
  ($t != null and now - $t <= 360 and $t - now <= 120) as $fresh |
  def value($key):
    ([$rows[] | select(.field == $key and .p.interval.endTime == $end)] | first | .p.value.int64Value) as $raw |
    (try ($raw | tonumber) catch null) as $v |
    if $fresh and $v != null and $v >= 0 and ($v | floor) == $v then $v else null end;
  [[{"key":"restart_age_seconds","label":"Running for"}][] as $f |
    (value($f.key)) as $v |
    {key: $f.label,
     value: (if $v == null then null
             elif $f.state_key != null and value($f.state_key) == null then null
             elif $f.state_key != null and value($f.state_key) == 0 then -1
             elif $f.state_key != null and value($f.state_key) == 2 then -2
             else $v * ($f.scale // 1) end)}] |
  from_entries
end

targets.root_selector:
# Railway public status (Instatus, railway.instatus.com/summary.json; Railway hosts Metabase and
# the reports). Live when healthy: {"page": {"name": "Railway", "url": ..., "status": "UP"}}; when
# not, page.status is HASISSUES or UNDERMAINTENANCE and the optional arrays activeIncidents
# ({name, impact, status, started}) and activeMaintenances ({name, status, start}) list the events.
# Status codes as the Google Cloud row: 0 Outage (a MAJOROUTAGE incident), 2 Incident open (any
# active incident or HASISSUES), 3 Maintenance (an in-progress maintenance or UNDERMAINTENANCE),
# 1 No incident (UP, nothing active), 4 Feed unreadable (anything else, including a changed shape).
def listed($k): (.[$k] // []) | if type == "array" then [.[] | select(type == "object")] else null end;
if type != "object" or (.page | type) != "object" or (.page.status | type) != "string"
   or listed("activeIncidents") == null or listed("activeMaintenances") == null
then {name: "Railway", status: 4, details: "Railway status feed unreadable or format changed."}
else
  listed("activeIncidents") as $incidents |
  [listed("activeMaintenances")[] | select((.status // "INPROGRESS") == "INPROGRESS")] as $maintenance |
  .page.status as $page |
  {name: "Railway",
   status: (if any($incidents[]; .impact == "MAJOROUTAGE") then 0
            elif ($incidents | length) > 0 or $page == "HASISSUES" then 2
            elif ($maintenance | length) > 0 or $page == "UNDERMAINTENANCE" then 3
            elif $page == "UP" then 1 else 4 end),
   details: (if ($incidents | length) + ($maintenance | length) == 0 then "Railway status: " + $page + "."
     else ([$incidents[] | (.name // "Incident") + " · " + ((.impact // .status // "") | tostring)] +
           [$maintenance[] | (.name // "Maintenance") + " · maintenance"] | join("\n")) end)}
end

# Google Cloud public incidents feed (status.cloud.google.com/incidents.json, an
# array). Open incidents (no end) whose affected products include a service MW
# Credit uses and whose current locations are empty (global) or include
# asia-southeast1 or global: status 2 with titles and update time; none 1; a
# response that is not the documented array shape 4 (feed unreadable).
def bkk: try (sub("[.][0-9]+"; "") | sub("[+]00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 | . + 25200 |
  strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M ICT")) catch "time unavailable";
["Cloud Run", "Cloud SQL", "Vertex AI", "Cloud Scheduler", "Cloud Monitoring", "Firebase Hosting"] as $products |
if type != "array" or any(.[]; type != "object" or ((.affected_products // []) | type) != "array")
then {name: "Google Cloud", status: 4, details: "Google Cloud status feed unreadable or format changed."}
else
  [.[] | select(.end == null) |
    select(any(.affected_products[]?; (.title // "") as $t | any($products[]; . as $p | $t | contains($p)))) |
    select(((.currently_affected_locations // []) | length) == 0 or
      any(.currently_affected_locations[]?; .id == "asia-southeast1" or .id == "global"))] as $open |
  {name: "Google Cloud",
   status: (if ($open | length) > 0 then 2 else 1 end),
   details: (if ($open | length) == 0 then "No open incident for Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Vertex AI, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Monitoring or Firebase Hosting in asia-southeast1 or global."
     else ([$open[] | (.external_desc // "Incident") + " · " + ((.most_recent_update.status // .severity // "") | tostring) +
       " · updated " + ((.most_recent_update.when // "") | bkk)] | join("\n")) end)}
end

# State timeline row: every sample in the range as a state code (0 Down, 1 OK,
# 2 Degraded, 3 Paused, 4 Unknown). Booleans map true 1, false 0. Samples of one
# collector run share a timestamp; the worst member wins (0, 4, 2, 3, then 1) and
# a run missing any of the 1 members is Unknown. A gap longer than
# the freshness bound ends in null at (sample + bound), so no state stretches across
# missing telemetry; a newest sample older than the bound also ends in null at
# (sample + bound), with a second null at now so Unknown reaches the right edge.
# Provider errors and truncation fail visibly.
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601;
def code: if type == "boolean" then (if . then 1 else 0 end)
  else (try tonumber catch null) | if . != null and IN(0, 1, 2, 3, 4) then . else 4 end end;
def worst: if any(.[]; . == 0) then 0 elif any(.[]; . == 4) then 4 elif any(.[]; . == 2) then 2
  elif any(.[]; . == 3) then 3 else 1 end;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Monitoring response truncated; shorten the time range")
else
  [.timeSeries[]? | .points[]? |
    {t: (try (.interval.endTime | stamp) catch null),
     v: (.value | if has("boolValue") then .boolValue else (.int64Value // .doubleValue) end)}] |
  map(select(.t != null and .t <= now + 120)) |
  group_by(.t) | map({t: .[0].t, n: length, v: ([.[].v | code] | worst)}) as $runs |
  [range(0; $runs | length) as $i | $runs[$i] as $r |
    {time: ($r.t | todateiso8601), value: (if $r.n == 1 then $r.v else 4 end)},
    (if $i + 1 < ($runs | length) and $runs[$i + 1].t - $r.t > 360
     then {time: ($r.t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null} else empty end)] +
  (if ($runs | length) == 0 then [{time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   elif now - ($runs | last | .t) > 360
   then [{time: ($runs | last | .t + 360 | todateiso8601), value: null}, {time: (now | floor | todateiso8601), value: null}]
   else [] end) |
  .[]
end
